verdict.rationale: Drata's developer docs say it can automate compliance workflows with custom triggers and actions and monitor controls, evidence, and personnel. That is workflow automation adjacent to the story, but no item says triggers can be time-based or that jobs can run on a recurring schedule. Missing for 10: explicit recurring or cron-style scheduling of workflows, documentation of schedule configuration (frequency, timing), API or agent-driven schedule management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
